newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber open interest lowest since Aug 1994.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber open interest lowest since Aug 1994.

text.p: Open interest in yen-based rubber futures on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) fell to 230,401 lots as of October 2, the lowest level since August 1994, a TOCOM spokesman said on Thursday.
The open interest was down from 398,742 lots at the end of January this year, TOCOM said.

The spokesman said a lack of fresh incentives, and easing demand/supply situations in Japan, combined with investors shifting to more volatile grain futures, were the main reasons behind the falling open interest. "Private investors are tending to liquidate their longs on any price rally," he said.
